text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified them nor does it vouch for their accuracy.
- Macedonian Foreign Minister Ljubomir Frckoski told a news conference on Monday "Macedonia does not expect much of the talks over its name to be held with Greece in New York."
- Price of petrol went up by two denars per litre as of midnight Monday to 38.50 denars (1.4 German marks). The government explains the measure by the price of oil on the world market.
- Cabinet of Prime Minister Branko Crvenkovski denied rumours of a government reshuffle. Justice Minister Vlado Popovski had expressed the wish to go back to teaching law.

- Macedonia asked for $287 million from the Security Council compensation commission for losses incurred by Macedonian construction companies caused by the Iraq-Kuwait war. Three Macedonian companies had completed big projects in these countries.
